# grokctl

> Unofficial command-line interface for the Grok Bot desktop app (Windows). Lets terminal AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Maestri multi-agent teams send tasks to Grok bots and read their replies.

Grok Bot has no official CLI or API. grokctl restarts the app with the Chrome DevTools port on 127.0.0.1 and drives its UI: it types into the composer, clicks Send, and reads the transcript.

## Usage

- `grokctl bots`: list Grok bots
- `grokctl create <name>`: create a bot
- `grokctl ask --bot <name> "<task>"`: send a task and wait for the reply
- `grokctl ask --no-wait ...`, `grokctl state`, `grokctl read [n]`: long-running tasks
- Setup: `npm install`, then `scripts/start-grok-bot.ps1`
